name: Capacity reconciliation tolerance
how_computed: When charactersUsed is known counted total S must satisfy |S - charactersUsed| <= 600; when only the percentage was captured the band is A*(P-0.005)/100 <= S < A*(P+0.005)/100. This tolerance reconciles the banner and the synchronized catalog; it is not added to the customer's selection target.

name: Scheduled-job purge window
how_computed: CronJobDetail CronTrigger and AsyncApexJob rows purge seven days after completion; a snapshot older than this covers only still-queued schedules

name: Reasoning batch size
how_computed: Packages above this many rows are split into fragments of at most this size, each reasoned alone; smaller packages are batched up to this many rows per agent; lower it when a batch's payload would exceed the agent's context
who_sets: method default; the analyst may lower it and records the value used in decisions_log

name: Realized-capacity reconciliation tolerance
how_computed: Post-deployment Tooling delta must match the Setup figure movement within this many characters to be reported as confirmed realized

name: Mass-deployment cluster
how_computed: At least this many members of one component with lastModifiedDate values in the same minute are one deployment event; the recent-modification rescue signal is discounted for them

name: Candidate-tool polling
how_computed: get_unused_apex_candidates is re-called with identical arguments every 30 seconds; still computing after 60 polls (30 minutes) is reported as not completed - the card stays put and the user is told

name: Signed-URL life
how_computed: The bundle URL the tool returns expires after this long; fetch at once and re-call the tool for a fresh one on failure; never store the URL

name: Plan regenerations before escalation
how_computed: A BLOCKS finding that survives this many generator runs goes to the customer's reviewer as a keep-or-rewrite question rather than another plan adjustment

name: Unused window N
how_computed: A class or trigger is a candidate when its lastExecuted.date (direct or inferred) is older than the N-day Coordinated Universal Time window ending yesterday or absent; the ledger states the requested and effective windows
who_sets: fixed by the method; card 02 passes it to the tool

name: Minimum telemetry span
how_computed: 30 published days arrive as 29 held when the ingest runs before Salesforce publishes the newest log; the engagement blocks with INSUFFICIENT_TELEMETRY below this value and produces no candidate list

name: Event Monitoring on
how_computed: One returned daily log date means the Event Monitoring add-on is on.
